name: Honda Power Equipment Mfg. - Swepsonville NC

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate at any public road. The campus is set well back from NC-119 (west) behind dense woods; the main access is an open driveway off the east-side road into the parking lot — no barrier arm, no guard booth, no checkpoint pinch-point. Truck docks and drop yards are reached via private internal roads inside the wooded campus. Classified false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at the entrance driveway or anywhere along the property perimeter in Street View (2023) or satellite.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved internal aprons in front of the central and NW dock banks provide ample inside-property holding/queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long private access road from the public road through the campus to the docks easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Multiple dedicated trailer-storage lots: a long SW row of ~25+ trailers parked nose-out, plus NW and central drop rows. Clearly separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 60+ dock doors estimated across multiple building faces (NW bank, central dock zone between buildings, SW building). High trailer density backed in. Count is an honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Drop lots hold well over 50 trailers without tractors across the SW, NW and central rows.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is split across physically separate banks on different building faces (NW face vs central courtyard vs SW building) consistent with separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has 4 distinct large buildings: main plant, NW production building, central buildings, and a separate older west building, plus north test/proving fields.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open private access roads and broad aprons leave room to add bypass/express lanes.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Driveway is a wide open 2-lane apron; exact lane count for trucks not separately marked. Low confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Web sources state an 87-acre site; perimeter box captures the developed core plus north test field — ~95 acres estimate.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
